claim: Solidus is a complete open source e-commerce solution built with Ruby on Rails and is a fork of Spree
Main gem installs solidus_api, solidus_backend, solidus_core and solidus_sample; core gem can be used alone with a custom frontend, admin and API
Install generator runs migrations and adds seed and sample data by default
DB can be SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB; Docker Compose setup for development
Master branch is not guaranteed to work and is too risky for production
Default admin email admin@example.com and password test123
README documents Docker Compose only in the Developing Solidus section; no production deployment guide in README
